mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weather_today_cache ( region_id, temp, sky, pty, wind, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{regionId}, #{temp}, #{sky}, #{pty}, #{wind}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE temp = VALUES(temp), sky = VALUES(sky), pty = VALUES(pty), wind = VALUES(wind), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT region_id AS regionId, temp, sky, pty, wind, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM weather_today_cache WHERE region_id = #{regionId}
SELECT region_id AS regionId, temp, sky, pty, wind, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM weather_today_cache
